edge_type_definitions.execution_requires: The upstream product must exist before execution.
edge_type_definitions.fit_domain_requires: The fitted object may inspect only the declared training domain.
edge_type_definitions.implementation_requires: The upstream interface/implementation must exist, but its deferred runtime qualification need not yet have passed.
edge_type_definitions.optional_enrichment: The upstream product enriches but is not required for the base path.
edge_type_definitions.promotion_requires: The upstream product must pass a declared predicate.
edge_type_definitions.release_qualification_requires: The upstream item must pass before the final production release, but does not block intermediate implementation development.
edge_type_definitions.replay_triggers: The upstream event creates a new immutable generation.
edge_type_definitions.source_identity_requires: Exact source or checkpoint identity is required.
edge_type_definitions.supersedes: The downstream/current authority intentionally replaces the scientific meaning of the upstream historical authority; historical evidence remains archival.

forbidden_dependencies.reason: Locked-test physical-observable evidence shall not tune comparison policies, training, data selection, or checkpoint decisions.
Post-training physical validation shall not retroactively alter data selection or the frozen training protocol.
Cross-system software qualification is a release gate and shall not tune scientific features, selections, protocols, or checkpoints.
Foundation features and residual E0 must be derived from verified DATA6/DATA7 artifacts.
Qualification must bind the immutable ProductionCorpusPlan.
Replay semantic identity must include numerical label payloads.
Campaign cleanup may reference external user inputs for provenance but shall never acquire deletion authority over user-supplied source or replay material.
Partial multi-fidelity screening evidence cannot authorize final scientific admissibility, checkpoint selection, or protocol freeze.
Partial or full checkpoint-evaluation evidence shall not tune or rewrite a frozen training precision schedule or stage transition.
